summary: Retested Master Admin ASER Settings panel after wiring fix. Navigation Master Admin → Overview → MoD sub-tab → 'MOD Console & ASER' inner tab now works. AdminMODConsole renders with AserSettingsPanel at the top. All 16 controls plus save button visible after expanding. Edits (threshold=3, service desk enabled + email) saved via PUT /api/master-admin/aser/settings, success toast 'ASER settings saved' displayed, and values persisted after full page reload. Panel state reset to defaults (threshold=2, SD disabled, email cleared) at end.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: aser-set-sd-enabled and aser-set-am-enabled are rendered as native checkboxes (not Radix switches) and expose neither aria-checked nor data-state — used input.checked to verify visually via screenshots. Consider adding aria-checked for programmatic testability.
seed_data_creation: Temporary edits made and reverted: threshold 2→3→2, service desk enabled+email set→cleared+disabled. Final DB state matches pre-test defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Panel is reachable at /master-admin → Overview → MoD → MOD Console & ASER. All data-testids match the review request. Persistence verified via PUT /api/master-admin/aser/settings + GET on reload.
rca of the issue: Previous orphan wiring was fixed by adding {id:'console', label:'MOD Console & ASER'} to modTabs in OverviewSection.js (line 62) and rendering <AdminMODConsole API={API}/> when modInnerTab==='console' (lines 187-189). Verified working end-to-end.
